nameOrigin: of great size/importance; lord or master

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

pokedexEntries.vi: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

pokedexEntries.za: Although it boasts fantastic strength and a huge body that stirs up great waves when it thrashes, Dondozo struggles at catching prey.
